what: Clicking a same-site link blooms a line-color curtain from a flat rectangle at the bottom center of the screen (25% to 75% wide, one row 75% high) to the full screen over 1.6s cubic-bezier(.9,0,.1,1), and hands over at 85% (1.36s). The arriving page starts with the curtain already open by the remaining amount: the mark at the curtain center fades out 12px upward in .45s, and .3s later the whole curtain lifts upward over 1.15s cubic-bezier(.87,0,.13,1)

options.dur: Duration in seconds for the curtain to bloom, default 1.6 — shorten for screens switched often
options.lift: Duration (s) of the curtain lifting from the incoming side, default 1.15
options.ease: Cover curve like ”0.9,0,0.1,1” (default), numbers or a css name
options.[data-fx-part=mark]: Mark to float at the center of the curtain (optional, hidden logo or image) — clone to use
options.fx:leave · fx:revealed: Events raised from the element when the transition starts · when the incoming side’s curtain has fully lifted

note: The page being navigated to must carry the same part so it can pick up where it left off (continued using the time in sessionStorage). The original’s first-visit burgundy curtain (lifts after the picture is drawn) and the elliptical fold when arriving from the phone menu exist only in the site’s shared.js

from.where: shared.js transition cover — original PageRevealer·page-cover (Brand cover, polygon 25% 75% → full screen, 1600ms·.85)
